design_philosophy: Extreme simplicity, high contrast, and zero clutter. Designed specifically for non-technical users. Every interaction must be obvious. Typography and spacing do the heavy lifting for hierarchy.

grid_system.launchpad: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5 gap-6 md:gap-8

spacing_and_layout.surfaces: Use flat solid surfaces. No glassmorphism. Crisp 1px borders with subtle shadows.
spacing_and_layout.radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-xl for inputs/buttons.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards must elevate slightly (hover:-translate-y-1) and increase shadow (hover:shadow-lg).

LaunchpadCard.description: Large square tile for each link. Clean and obvious.
LaunchpadCard.container: aspect-square bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-200 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 gap-4 cursor-pointer text-center
LaunchpadCard.logo_wrapper: h-20 w-20 md:h-24 md:w-24 flex items-center justify-center mb-2
LaunchpadCard.text: font-semibold text-lg md:text-xl text-slate-900 line-clamp-2 leading-tight

SearchBar.description: Prominent, large search input centered at the top.
SearchBar.input: w-full h-16 pl-14 pr-6 text-xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 rounded-2xl shadow-sm focus:border-blue-600 focus:ring-0 transition-colors
SearchBar.icon: absolute left-5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 w-6 h-6

AdminToggle.styles: fixed bottom-6 right-6 p-3 text-slate-300 hover:text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 opacity-30 hover:opacity-100 z-50

AdminPanel.description: Standard Shadcn UI implementation for dashboard.
AdminPanel.table: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for structure or simple Shadcn Table. Must include drag handle for custom ordering.
AdminPanel.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Switch, Dialog for editing.

placeholders.app_logo: Use lucide-react 'Wrench' or 'Settings' icon for default top-left brand.
placeholders.card_logo: Use lucide-react 'Globe' or 'Link' icon for tiles missing a logo.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over cards is minimum 4.5:1. (Slate 900 on White is ~15:1).
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Examples: data-testid='card-link-1', data-testid='search-input', data-testid='admin-toggle', data-testid='admin-login-submit'.

instructions_to_main_agent.architecture: Hybrid Fullstack. Use FastAPI for backend APIs and SQLite database. Use React (.js) with Vite for frontend.
instructions_to_main_agent.frontend_setup: Install Tailwind, lucide-react, react-router-dom, @dnd-kit/core (for drag-and-drop), and shadcn UI primitives (dialog, input, switch, table, toast).
instructions_to_main_agent.backend_setup: FastAPI with SQLAlchemy (SQLite). Create models for: Link (id, title, url, logo_url, clicks, is_active, custom_order, created_at) and Settings (id, sort_mode, open_in_new_tab).
instructions_to_main_agent.auth_flow: Implement simple session or JWT token auth for the admin routes. Hardcode or auto-generate a temporary admin password on first boot, output it to console, and provide a way to change it. Unauthenticated users cannot see edit forms.
instructions_to_main_agent.link_handling: When a card is clicked, first fire an async POST to `/api/links/{id}/click` to increment stats, then navigate to the URL. Use `target='_blank'` based on settings.
instructions_to_main_agent.file_handling: Implement a simple local upload endpoint in FastAPI to save logo images to a static folder, or allow storing external URLs directly.
